newsitem.title: UK: UK's FTSE 100 turns down as sterling edges up.
newsitem.headline: UK's FTSE 100 turns down as sterling edges up.

text.p: Britain's leading share index turned slightly lower early on Thursday when sterling reasserted its strength and a batch of earnings reports failed to boost four of the FTSE 100 component companies.
The FTSE 100 fell 7.5 points to 4,919.8 by 0754 GMT.
It opened slightly higher but failed to match its opening call following its one percent gain on Wednesday and a record run on Wall Street.
